title: Pirsm Vanilla
description: Vanilla+ Minecraft with better performance, enhanced visuals, useful UI improvements, and the return of the craftable Enchanted Golden Apple.
body:
# Prism Modpack

A Vanilla+ experience designed for players who want Minecraft to feel better, not different.

This modpack focuses on performance, utility, and immersion while staying true to the core Minecraft experience. Enjoy improved UI features, helpful quality-of-life additions, carefully selected resource packs, and optimized shader settings that look great without turning your PC into a furnace.

Built with performance in mind, this pack includes optimization mods that help even low-end and older systems achieve smooth, playable framerates. Whether you're running a gaming rig or a potato-powered machine, Minecraft should be enjoyable.

Features:
• Vanilla-friendly gameplay
• Useful UI and quality-of-life improvements
• Optimized shaders for low-end PCs
• Resource packs that enhance the visual experience
• Performance mods for maximum FPS
• Carefully balanced enhancements that respect vanilla Minecraft
• The Enchanted Golden Apple is craftable again—because some things should never have been removed

If you love Minecraft's original vision but want it smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable, this pack is for you.
